text:
When they told me, I felt the cold
of a steel blade in my entrails;
I leaned against the wall and for a moment
lost all sense of where I was.

Night fell upon my spirit;
my soul was engulfed in anger and pity...
And then I understood why people weep,
and then I understood why people kill!

The cloud of grief passed... With pain
I managed to stammer a few words...
Who had brought me the news? A faithful friend...
He had done me a great favor! I thanked him.

translation.title: Rhyme XLII: When They Told Me, I Felt the Cold
